page.title: Network
page.description: Where every app and database runs, and how they reach each other. Internal zone {{zone}}.

group.unplacedHint: These resources are placed on a node this control plane does not know ({{ids}}). Move them to this server, or re-add the node.
group.moveHint: Open an app or database and choose a node to move it to this server.

resource.noMeshAddressHint: This resource is on a node that has no mesh address, so other nodes cannot reach it.

legend.title: How to read this page
legend.server: A server running Levelrail. The first card is the control plane itself.
legend.internalName: The internal name other apps use to reach this resource. Click the copy button to use it in a connection string.
legend.local: Local means the resource is on this server and reachable directly, no mesh needed.
legend.mesh: With the mesh on, resources on other servers get a mesh address and the same internal name works across servers.

empty.title: Nothing running yet
empty.description: Deploy an app or create a database and it appears here, grouped by the server it runs on.

error.load: Could not load the network overview.

mesh.title: Mesh networking
mesh.description: A private WireGuard network between your servers, so apps and databases on different servers reach each other by internal name. You only need it when you manage more than one server.
mesh.pinned: Set by {{envVar}} on the server. Unset it there to manage the mesh from here.
mesh.enableDescription: The mesh is saved now and starts when the control plane restarts.
mesh.disableDescription: The mesh stops at the next control plane restart.
mesh.disableNodes: {{count}} other node(s) are enrolled and reach this control plane over the mesh. Disabling disconnects them.
mesh.restartRequired: Restart the control plane to apply this change.
mesh.blocked: Fix the blocked checks first, then enable the mesh.
mesh.rootOnly: Only an administrator can change this.
mesh.enableConsequence1: This server opens a WireGuard interface and listens on a UDP port (51820 by default).
mesh.enableConsequence2: Agents on other nodes connect to this control plane over the mesh.
mesh.enableConsequence3: Apps and databases get internal addresses reachable across servers.
mesh.disableConsequence1: Apps and databases on other servers lose their cross-server internal addresses.
mesh.disableConsequence2: Everything on this server keeps working locally.
